toa-net.product: CERES EBAF TOA and Surface Fluxes. Monthly Averages and 07/2005 to 06/2015 Climatology.
toa-net.product_version: Edition 4.2.1; Revised data Release Date March 14, 2025

variable.name: toa_net_all_mon
variable.long_name: Top of The Atmosphere Net Flux, All-Sky conditions, Monthly Means

toa-net.grid: 180 by 360 one degree cells, latitude centres -89.5 to 89.5, longitude centres 0.5 to 359.5
toa-net.weights: cos-latitude at the cell centre, every cell that carries a value; the product's own global mean (gtoa_net_all_mon, written as the fourth column) uses the project's zonal geodetic weights, an oblate spheroid with the solar division factor 4.0034 (the data quality summary)
toa-net.mask: none beyond the product's fill: 64800 to 64800 of 64800 cells carry a value
toa-net.aggregation: one global mean per calendar month in W m-2, as the product carries it: positive downward, all-sky, anchored (the anchoring block)

anchoring.statement: the global mean net TOA flux over July 2005 through June 2015 is set to the in situ heat uptake of 0.71 W m-2 (uncertainty 0.10 at the 95 percent level) by a one-time adjustment of the shortwave and longwave fluxes, unchanged from Edition 4.1 into 4.2 and 4.2.1; the bundle's ebaf-imbalance-anchored-to-ocean-heating gotcha and the Edition 4.2 and 4.0 data quality summaries

toa-net.uncertainty_basis: stated noise floor: standard deviation of adjacent-month differences of the series with its calendar-month means removed, divided by sqrt(2); the product ships no uncertainty field
toa-net.published_monthly_random_error_note: the random error of a global monthly anomaly after the satellite transitions is estimated below 0.15 W m-2 (Loeb and others 2024, the dataset concept); the floor above is measured on this series, the published number is for comparison

weighting_cross_check.rule: cos-latitude mean minus the product's geodetic global mean, per month

attempts.credentials: Earthdata Login bearer token as a request header

ocean_input.statement: the 0 to 2000 dbar ocean heat content rate is read from the Argo receipt ohc-2000-receipt.json in this root (references/computations/argo_ohc.py, run sha256:0f64c6f9f2f330b6, window 2006-01:2020-12), produced by the ocean-science plugin's computation on its committed data root argo-ohc-root-2026-09-15
ocean_input.domain: the columns that carry a value at all 58 levels in every month written (the product's own fill marks a level as unmapped; marginal seas mapped to a shallower limit than 2000 dbar therefore drop out), applied to both layers so the two share one domain; latitudes -64.5 to 65.5, 30650 of 52200 cells
ocean_input.note: the rate is over the product's mapped open-ocean domain and is never scaled to the global ocean
